description: A park is designing their trails and can either create a wide trail or a narrow trail. A wide trail can take 50 visitors every day while the narrow trail expects 20 visitors every day. The wide trail will introduce 6 units of garbage and the narrow trail will introduce 3 units of garbage. There can be at most 3 wide trails and the park hopes to have at most 225 visitors every day. How many of each type of trail should the park construct to minimize the total amount of garbage produced.

MaxWideTrails.definition: Maximum number of wide trails allowed

MaxVisitorsPerDay.definition: Maximum number of visitors allowed per day

VisitorsPerWideTrail.definition: Number of visitors per day on a wide trail

VisitorsPerNarrowTrail.definition: Number of visitors per day on a narrow trail

GarbagePerWideTrail.definition: Units of garbage produced per wide trail

GarbagePerNarrowTrail.definition: Units of garbage produced per narrow trail

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of garbage produced by the wide and narrow trails constructed"

constraints.description: The number of wide trails constructed must not exceed MaxWideTrails
VisitorsPerWideTrail * (number of wide trails) + VisitorsPerNarrowTrail * (number of narrow trails) must not exceed MaxVisitorsPerDay
The number of wide trails constructed must be a non-negative integer
The number of narrow trails constructed must be a non-negative integer
